messages.subject: Kingsgate House - service charge year-end query
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to current matters - on Kingsgate House (Project Redwood) the managing agent has sent through the service charge reconciliation for the year ended June and there's a balancing charge we didn't expect (c.£11k). Could someone have a quick look at the lease apportionment provisions when there's a gap? No rush - next week is fine.

Thanks,
Isla
